output.question: When is SpaceX's IPO date?
output.answer: SpaceX's IPO date—the first day its shares began trading—was June 12, 2026, on Nasdaq under the ticker SPCX ([SpaceX investor-relations release](https://ir.spacex.com/updates/releases-details/2026/Space-Exploration-Technologies-Corp--Announces-Pricing-of-Initial-Public-Offering/default.aspx); [CNBC coverage](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/spacex-ipo-spcx-live-updates.html)). SpaceX announced the IPO pricing on June 11, 2026, and said trading was expected to begin the following day; CNBC subsequently reported that the debut occurred on June 12.

key_facts.fact: SpaceX shares were scheduled to begin trading on June 12, 2026, on the Nasdaq Global Select Market and Nasdaq Texas under ticker SPCX.
CNBC reported that SpaceX made its Nasdaq debut on Friday, June 12, 2026.
The IPO was priced on June 11, 2026, at $135.00 per share; this is the pricing date, distinct from the first trading date.

passages.quote: The shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market and Nasdaq Texas on June 12, 2026, under the ticker symbol "SPCX."
SpaceX jumped 19% on Friday in its Nasdaq debut after the biggest initial public offering ever.

caveats: The term IPO date can refer either to the pricing date (June 11, 2026) or the first public trading date; for the usual investor meaning, the first trading date was June 12, 2026.
